# Castelblanco Law Group

> > California tenant rights and personal injury law firm founded by Harvard Law graduate Eric Castelblanco, specializing in habitability violations, security deposit disputes, and landlord negligence cases.

Castelblanco Law Group serves tenants and injury victims throughout California with bilingual legal services (English/Spanish). The firm focuses on enforcing California Civil Code §1950.5, habitability standards under Civil Code §1941.1, and premises liability claims against negligent landlords and property owners.

## Key Topics

- California tenant rights (derechos de inquilinos)
- California Civil Code §1950.5 (security deposits)
- California Civil Code §1941.1 (habitability standards)
- Landlord negligence and slumlord violations
- Personal injury and premises liability
- Security deposit disputes and wrongful deductions
- Habitability issues (bed bugs, roaches, water damage)
- Tenant legal representation (abogados para inquilinos)
- Wrongful death claims (muerte injusta)
- Legal compensation for housing violations (compensación legal)
- Eric Castelblanco, Harvard Law School graduate
- Immigration and tenant protections
- Workplace discrimination against immigrants
- California landlord-tenant law
- San Bernardino and Los Angeles tenant services
